description:
Kang-Beom, a tiger beast, and Kim Sang-Hyuk, a man with mysterious odd eyes, meet by chance at a DNA research lab that studies mutations, and are drawn to each other at first sight.
Sang-hyuk is the only one who can control Kang-beom, who runs rampant inside the lab.
